name: Classic Desktop
author: dieuwedeboer
description: A taskbar, floating windows and minimise for people coming from Windows or Plasma. No extra packages.

barWidget.description: One button per window: click to focus, click again to minimise, right-click for more.

schema.label: Windows shown
schema.description: Every window, or only those on this monitor's workspace. Minimised windows always show.

schema.label: Settings button
schema.description: Show the button that opens the Classic Desktop toggles.
